note: This course's outline was built before Microsoft's Unified Catalog rollout stabilized; current Microsoft Learn docs (learn.microsoft.com/purview/unified-catalog) confirm Data Catalog is the portal solution area and Unified Catalog is the business-concept-driven experience inside it (governance domains, data products, glossary terms, OKRs), distinct from the separate Data Map solution that performs scanning. This distinction, and all portal screenshots used, were cross-checked against the live docs rather than assumed. Microsoft's own official masterclass repo (github.com/microsoft/purview-data-governance-masterclass) was also reviewed for terminology cross-checks but no images from it were used in this specific lesson.
